name: NextPlus Banner
author: shariaone39

sections.description:
“I keep writing posts, but traffic never grows” — this plugin is a no-ad-budget way for WordPress sites to gain visitors.

NEXT+ is a mutual referral platform where websites, apps, and local shops introduce customers to each other. It is operated by us, the authors of this plugin. When you place the banner with this plugin:

  • Your readers see nearby deals from other participating sites and shops
  • Every time the banner is tapped, your site earns referral points
  • Your points determine how often your own site is recommended on other participating sites, bringing you new visitors

Unlike SEO or social media, there are no rankings or followers to grow first. Your site becomes part of the referral network the day you install the banner.

Note: the NEXT+ referral network currently connects websites in Japan, so the deals shown in the banner are Japanese. The plugin interface itself is in English and ships with a Japanese translation; translations into other languages are welcome.

Features

  • Just place it: choose from the [nextplus_banner] shortcode, a block, or automatic insertion after each post
  • No performance impact: the banner is lazy-loaded with a fixed height, so it causes no layout shift (CLS)
  • SEO-safe: the banner is delivered inside an iframe, so search engines do not treat it as link exchange
  • Always up to date: banner design improvements are delivered server-side, with no plugin update needed
  • Measurable: see impressions, clicks, and referrals in the NEXT+ analytics dashboard

How to start

  1. Sign up for NEXT+ and enter your site’s information
  2. In NEXT+, open Banners, click “Embed in your site or app” on your banner, and copy the URL from the green box at the top (“For WordPress users, this URL is all you need”). You do not need the iframe code
  3. Paste it in this plugin’s settings page (Settings > NEXT+ Banner) and save

The plugin itself is free. The NEXT+ service is free forever for the first 150 registered businesses as long as the banner stays installed; registrations after that are planned to be on a paid plan (JPY 3,980 per month, tax included). No credit card is required to sign up. See the Pricing section below.

External Services

This plugin connects to the external service “NEXT+” (https://www.nextplus.link), which is operated by the plugin authors, to display the banner.

  • What is loaded: the banner (an iframe) corresponding to the installation token you save in the settings page is loaded from nextplus.link
  • What is sent: when the banner is displayed or clicked, the visitor’s browser sends the same information as any normal web request (IP address, User-Agent, etc.) to the NEXT+ server. The plugin itself does not send any personal data stored in your WordPress site
  • Terms of service: https://www.nextplus.link/terms
  • Privacy policy: https://www.nextplus.link/privacy

A NEXT+ account is required to display the banner. NEXT+ is a paid service with a free tier: the first 150 registered businesses use the basic features free forever while the banner stays installed, and registrations after that are planned to be charged JPY 3,980 per month (tax included) through the NEXT+ website. The plugin never processes payments and does not change its behavior based on your plan.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Sign up for NEXT+ (free) and enter your site’s information
  3. In NEXT+, open Banners, click “Embed in your site or app” on your banner, and copy the URL from the green box at the top (“For WordPress users, this URL is all you need”)
  4. Paste it in Settings > NEXT+ Banner and save
  5. Turn on automatic insertion after posts, or place the [nextplus_banner] shortcode or the “NEXT+ Banner” block where you want the banner to appear
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

The plugin is free (GPL). The NEXT+ service it connects to has a free tier and a paid plan:

  • The first 150 registered businesses use the basic features free forever, as long as the banner stays installed
  • Registrations from the 151st business onward are planned to be on a paid plan of JPY 3,980 per month (tax included)
  • No credit card is required to sign up, and businesses that registered while the free tier was open are never charged later

The current number of remaining free slots is shown on https://www.nextplus.link/ . Payment, if any, is handled on the NEXT+ website, never inside WordPress.

How does my traffic grow?

Every time your banner is tapped (= you send a reader to another site), your site earns referral points. Your points determine how often your own site is recommended in other participating sites’ banner slots and in the NEXT+ AI-powered search. The more you send, the more you are recommended.

Can any site join?

Any publicly available site can join, regardless of genre. All participating sites are reviewed by the NEXT+ team.

Is this the same as reciprocal linking?

No. Reciprocal links are an SEO technique of exchanging links for search-engine ranking, which risks penalties when overdone. The NEXT+ banner is delivered inside an iframe, so it is not counted as a backlink by search engines. Instead, it introduces real human readers between sites.

Does the banner slow down my site?

No. It is lazy-loaded, so it does not delay your page’s initial render, and its height is fixed so it causes no layout shift (CLS).
sections.changelog:
0.1.6

  • Clearer instructions for finding the link URL: NEXT+ now shows a dedicated “For WordPress users, this URL is all you need” box at the top of the embed panel, and the settings page and readme point to it (based on a monitor report that the URL was hard to find inside the iframe code)

0.1.5

  • Clarified pricing: the plugin stays free, while the NEXT+ service is free forever for the first 150 businesses and moves to a paid plan (planned JPY 3,980/month) for later registrations. Updated the description, External Services section, FAQ, and the settings page notice accordingly

0.1.4

  • Added: the banner now reports that it was installed through this plugin, so we can see which distribution channels lead to actual installs. No personal data is sent.

0.1.3

  • Changed: all source strings are now written in English, so the plugin can be translated into any language
  • Added: bundled Japanese translation (languages/) and translations for the block editor
  • Removed: the Japanese-only description section from the readme, which is now covered by the Japanese translation

0.1.2

  • Fixed: the automatic insertion after posts now works on block themes
  • Improved: Japanese description for the plugin directory search

0.1.1

  • Removed the banner preview iframe from the admin settings page
  • Rewrote the readme and plugin headers in English

0.1.0

  • Initial release: shortcode, block, automatic insertion after posts, settings page
